title: Define dashboard and OpenAPI auth, API-key scope, and route middleware boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard auth, JWT login, API key CRUD, OpenAPI scopes, and route middleware are separate concerns from dashboard status DTOs. Rust should add typed auth and API-key ports before management mutations or external OpenAPI routes grow.

files.change: Separate JWT/session auth policy from management route handlers.
Model API-key scopes, hashing, issuance, revocation, and request extraction outside route handlers.
Persist API keys through storage traits rather than dashboard internals.

criteria: Management routes can be protected without embedding JWT/API-key logic in every handler.
OpenAPI scopes are typed and testable independently.
API keys use storage/repository ports instead of direct route state.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
